BL-953 — A git_handoff's task and commit headers are never checked against each other, so a commit belonging to one ticket rides two pipeline hops under another ticket's name
What it solves: Surfaced 2026-08-19 by the architect, which reported a "stray
cleaner->architect handoff" to the coordinator; the coordinator relayed
it to the specifier as "Cleaner mislabeled BL-935 handoff w/ BL-949's
commit 7185e63" (two notes, ids ...000574 and ...000575). That
attribution is wrong and is corr…
Approval context: Firm: the defect is measured, not inferred - the two coder parcels 39 seconds apart are on disk, and the commits they cite are on main.
What needs sign-off is the fail-open posture. This gate deliberately lets a mislabel through whenever it cannot positively prove one, because the alternative - blo…
